claims.claim: The prime minister stated that one million young people in the United Kingdom are neither working nor in training or education.

claims.claim: The Ghana Association of University Administrators and the Technical University Senior Administrators Association suspended their industrial action once roughly 80 percent of their grievances had been addressed.
claims.episode_span: The Ghana Association of University Administrators and the Technical University Senior Administrators Association suspended their industrial action once roughly 80 percent of their grievances had been addressed through talks with the government.
claims.source_title: Ghana: GAUA Calls Off Strike As Govt Addresses 80% of Grievances
claims.supporting_quote: The Ghana Association of University Administrators (GAUA) and the Technical University Senior Administrators Association of Ghana (TUSAAG) have suspended their strike after about 80 per cent of their grievances were addressed through engagements with the government.
